metadata.name: credit_gate
metadata.description: Gate Program for Token ACL (sRFC37): eligibility, block-list, holder governor, lot ledger (SRS 08 §4.1, doc 09). Audit-scope-critical.

instructions.name: accept_gate_authority
docs: Step 2 of 2: the proposed key signs to take over. Proving it can sign
before anything moves means a typo'd or unreachable key can never
strand the config.

accounts.name: pending
docs: Rent goes to the incoming authority (#96): the outgoing one is
typically the bootstrap key being retired at hand-over, whose
lamports would otherwise be stranded with it.

accounts.name: new_authority
docs: The proposed key; must sign. Receives the pending rent.

accounts.name: proposed_by
docs: cannot accept against a proposal it misidentifies.

instructions.name: accept_root_authority
docs: Step 2 of 2: the proposed key signs to take over the root.

accounts.name: new_authority
docs: The proposed key; must sign.

instructions.name: append_lot
docs: CG-P3 `append_lot`: record `qty` acquired now, seasoning for the
config's `seasoning_seconds`. Gate-config authority only (it stands
in for auction-engine settle and the primary mint). Re-screens the
holder: block-list precedence on every path (CG-P5).

instructions.name: block_wallet
docs: CG-P5: block `wallet` on this market. Fails if already blocked.

accounts.name: entry
docs: `init` fails if the wallet is already blocked.

instructions.name: can_freeze_permissionless
docs: Token ACL `can-freeze-permissionless` hook: succeeds iff the owner is
no longer admitted (revocation).

accounts.name: owner
docs: account; `decide` re-checks).

accounts.name: extra_metas
docs: it by its PDA address, so only its existence matters here.

instructions.name: can_thaw_permissionless
docs: Token ACL `can-thaw-permissionless` hook (sRFC37): succeeds iff the
owner is admitted by the gate right now.

accounts.name: owner
docs: account; `decide` re-checks).

accounts.name: extra_metas
docs: it by its PDA address, so only its existence matters here.

instructions.name: cancel_gate_authority
docs: Withdraws a pending proposal. Only the current authority may cancel.

instructions.name: cancel_root_authority
docs: Withdraws a pending root hand-over. Only the root authority.

accounts.name: authority
docs: Current root authority.

instructions.name: check_blocklist
docs: CG-P5 screen as an instruction, so a caller (auction-engine's
settle-time re-check, AE-P8) can CPI it: succeeds iff `wallet` is
clear on this market, fails [`GateError::Blocklisted`] otherwise,
and fails closed on an unreadable list.

accounts.name: entry
docs: seeds; empty when the wallet is not blocked. Read by [`screen`].

instructions.name: custody_pledge
docs: LF-P5: `qty` of the pledgor's lots, with their dates, to the ledger
of pledge `pledge_ref` ([`pledge_holder`]). Custodian and pledgor
sign (the custodian's program moves the units in the same
instruction).

accounts.name: record
docs: The custodian's registration on this market.

accounts.name: pledgor
docs: The holder pledging; signs, as it signs the token transfer.

accounts.name: pledge_lots
docs: The pledge's ledger (`open_holder_lots(pledge_holder(..))` first).

instructions.name: custody_release
docs: LF-P5: `qty` of lots, with their dates, out of the custodian's own
ledger (`pledge_ref` = default) or pledge `pledge_ref`'s, to another
holder's ledger. Custodian signs.

instructions.name: custody_sale
docs: LF-P5: a sale out of custody — seasoned quantity debited (C2); an
admitted buyer gets a new lot, the issuer none. Custodian signs.

accounts.name: buyer_lots
docs: The buyer's ledger; omitted (with the link) for the issuer.

accounts.name: buyer_link
docs: The buyer's admission; omitted (with the ledger) for the issuer.

instructions.name: deregister_affiliate
docs: L6: `wallet` is no longer an affiliate (its record closes; rent to
the authority). Gate-config authority.

instructions.name: deregister_custodian
docs: Revoke a custodian (its ledgers stay; it can no longer move lots).

instructions.name: initialize_blocklist
docs: CG-P5: create the market's block-list header and point the config
at it. From then on every screen reads it, and `update_config` can
re-point but never clear it.

instructions.name: initialize_config
docs: CG-P2: initialize the per-mint market config. Called once per gated
mint. The signer must be the [`GateRoot`] authority, so the
first-caller-wins `init` cannot be front-run by anyone watching for a
new mint (#26), and onboarding keeps working after the program is
finalized (#93).

accounts.name: config
docs: Per-mint policy PDA (CG-P2).

accounts.name: root
docs: The gate root (#93); its authority is the only allowed signer.

accounts.name: mint
docs: this mint happens at ACL wiring in P1 (CG-P1).

accounts.name: authority
docs: Gate root authority (a single bootstrap key on devnet today, Squads
2-of-2 is the SRS 08 §8 target); becomes the gate-config authority
and pays rent. Rotate it later with `propose_gate_authority` +
`accept_gate_authority`.

instructions.name: initialize_policy
docs: CG-P1/P6: create the market's eligibility policy. Verifies both
config schemas are SAS schemas under `credential`.

accounts.name: identity_schema
docs: `credential` (checked by [`check_schema`]).

instructions.name: initialize_root
docs: Seeds the [`GateRoot`] (#93). One-shot (`init`), and only this
program's upgrade authority may call it, so it cannot be front-run
(#26). It names the root authority directly, so the upgrade key can
seed it straight to a Squads vault it does not control.

accounts.name: root
docs: The singleton root (#93); `init` makes this one-shot.

accounts.name: upgrade_authority
docs: Program upgrade authority; pays rent. Only it may seed the root.

accounts.name: program
docs: This program — used only to locate its ProgramData account.

accounts.name: program_data
docs: Holds the upgrade authority the signer must match. `None` once the
program is finalized, so a finalized program can never be re-rooted.

instructions.name: initialize_token_acl_metas
docs: CG-P1: write the Token ACL extra-account-meta lists for this mint
(`["thaw_extra_account_metas", mint]` and the freeze one).

instructions.name: merge_expired
docs: CG-P3 `merge_expired`: permissionless. Folds every seasoned lot into
the holder's FREE bucket. Fails [`GateError::NothingExpired`] when
there is nothing to fold, so every success is a state change.

instructions.name: migrate_config
docs: #202: give a market created before #202 its compliance tail
([`Compliance`], behind the unchanged `MarketConfig` struct), at the
defaults that keep its behaviour exactly: issuer flags set, no
ticket floor, `PolicyOnly`, no affiliate limit. Permissionless (the
payer funds the extra rent). Until it runs the market reads those
same defaults and `update_compliance` refuses; every program built
against the old layout keeps decoding the config either way.
Evented as `ConfigUpdated` with `field_group_ext = MIGRATED`.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Anyone; funds the extra rent.

instructions.name: open_holder_lots
docs: CG-P3: open the lot ledger for `holder` (anyone may pay). The holder
is screened first: a block-listed wallet gets no ledger.

instructions.name: project_and_check
docs: CG-P4 `project_and_check` (for auction-engine at allocation): fails
[`GateError::GovernorCap`] iff admitting `investor_id` would exceed
the cap. An already-admitted investor always passes.

accounts.name: investor
docs: the investor is new.

instructions.name: propose_gate_authority
docs: Step 1 of 2: the current `gate_config_authority` names its successor
(#50). The upgrade authority has no role here, so a Squads vault can
take over from a key it does not control. One pending proposal per
mint; `cancel_gate_authority` withdraws it.

accounts.name: pending
docs: One pending proposal per mint (`init` fails while one exists).

accounts.name: gate_config_authority
docs: Current authority (checked by `has_one`); pays the pending rent.

instructions.name: propose_root_authority
docs: Step 1 of 2 of a root hand-over: the root authority names its
successor. Re-proposing replaces the pending successor.

accounts.name: authority
docs: Current root authority.

instructions.name: record_seizure
docs: D14 / doc 09 Path 7: the audit-trail hook for a permanent-delegate
seizure. The transfer itself is Token-2022's (the mint's permanent
delegate moves the units); this instruction, signed by the
gate-config authority in the same transaction, emits
[`SeizureRecorded`] (mint, from, to, amount, reason hash) so every
use of the delegate is indexed next to the gate's other decisions.

instructions.name: register_affiliate
docs: L6: mark `wallet` an affiliate of the issuer on this market. Its
sales are then counted against `affiliate_volume_limit` per window
(`settle_check`). Gate-config authority.

instructions.name: register_custodian
docs: LF-P5 (CG-P3 custody): let `custodian` hold lots for others on this
market (liquidity-facility's signer PDA). Gate-config authority.

instructions.name: release_holder
docs: CG-P4 decrement: the gate-config authority releases `owner`; its
link closes, and its investor leaves the count with its last wallet.
Not on the authority's word alone (#202): the instruction must see
the exit to zero. The owner's lot ledger holds nothing, its
Token-2022 associated account for the mint is absent or empty, and
every further token account passed as a remaining account (each a
Token-2022 account of this mint and owner) is empty too
([`eligibility::require_exited`]). Completeness of that list is the
authority's (it finds them with `getTokenAccountsByOwner`); the
chain cannot enumerate a wallet's accounts, which is why release
stays authority-signed rather than permissionless: a caller hiding
a funded non-ATA account could otherwise undercount the governor.

accounts.name: lots
docs: absent.

accounts.name: token_account
docs: (address checked in `require_exited`); must be empty or absent.

instructions.name: settle_check
docs: AE-P8 settle-time re-check for one fill (#133, #134): block-list on
both sides, the buyer's admission and SAS attestations re-read, the
seller's seasoned lots debited, the buyer's lot appended. Signed only
by payment-rails' settlement PDA, inside `settle_fill`; any failure
aborts the fill. Returns what the transfer record needs.

accounts.name: settlement_authority
docs: payment-rails' settlement PDA: only `settle_fill` can sign for it.

accounts.name: seller_lots
docs: The seller's ledger; a seller without one has nothing seasoned.

accounts.name: buyer_lots
docs: The buyer's ledger (`validate` opened it).

accounts.name: buyer_link
docs: The buyer's admission: must exist (CG-P1/P4).

instructions.name: settle_check_rofr
docs: [`settle_check`](credit_gate::settle_check) for the issuer's ROFR
fill (AE-P7): block-list on both sides and the seller's seasoned
lots debited. The issuer is buying its own security back, so it is
not admitted as a holder and gets no lot.

instructions.name: split_lot
docs: CG-P3 `split_lot`: split `qty` off lot `lot_id`, both halves keeping
the original's seasoning and metadata. Gate-config authority only.

instructions.name: unblock_wallet
docs: CG-P5: unblock `wallet` (closes its entry; rent to the authority).

accounts.name: entry
docs: Closing the entry is the unblock; rent goes to the authority.

instructions.name: update_compliance
docs: CG-3 / CG-4 / CG-6 / L6 governed updates of the compliance tail
(#202), one `Option` per field like `update_config`, and evented the
same way (`ConfigUpdated`, bits in `field_group_ext`). Separate from
`update_config` so that instruction's wire format and every caller
built against it stay as they are.

accounts.name: config
docs: Per-mint policy PDA; only its governing authority may update.

accounts.name: gate_config_authority
docs: Current gate-config authority (checked by `has_one`).

instructions.name: update_config
docs: CG-P2: governed field updates. Every call emits `ConfigUpdated`.
Snapshot discipline: auction-engine snapshots config at session open;
the gate itself never mutates config mid-session (L5).

accounts.name: config
docs: Per-mint policy PDA; only its governing authority may update.

accounts.name: gate_config_authority
docs: Current gate-config authority (checked by `has_one`).

instructions.name: update_policy
docs: Governed policy edits. The credential is fixed at init: moving to a
new credential is a new market policy, not an edit.

instructions.name: validate
docs: CG-P1 `validate(owner, mint)`: block-list → SAS attestations →
expiry → policy → governor → lot-ledger init, every decision evented
as [`ValidateDecision`]. A rejection changes no state and succeeds
(so the event is kept); an approval writes the holder link that the
Token ACL hooks read.

accounts.name: investor
docs: identity attestation, so the address is checked in the handler.

accounts.name: lots
docs: approval if absent (CG-P1 step 5).

errors.name: ConfigFieldMissing
errors.msg: Config field required by this operation is not set

errors.name: NotUpgradeAuthority
errors.msg: Signer is not the program upgrade authority

errors.name: NotProposedAuthority
errors.msg: Signer is not the proposed gate authority

errors.name: NotRootAuthority
errors.msg: Signer is not the gate root authority

errors.name: NoPendingRootAuthority

errors.name: BlocklistUnreadable

errors.name: AttestationExpired

errors.name: NotTokenAclFlow

errors.name: TokenAccountMismatch

errors.name: SeasoningNotMet

errors.name: NotSettlementAuthority

errors.name: SelfTrade

errors.name: InsufficientLots

errors.name: NotCustodian

errors.name: NotCustodyLedger

errors.name: ConfigNotMigrated

errors.name: IssuerReportingStale

errors.name: BadActorUnscreened

errors.name: BelowMinTicket

errors.name: DistributionCompliance

errors.name: ExemptionClassClosed

errors.name: AffiliateVolumeExceeded

errors.name: RemainingAccountMismatch

errors.name: HolderNotExited
errors.msg: Holder still holds units of this mint

types.name: AffiliateRecord
docs: One registered issuer affiliate on one market, and its sale volume in
the current window (L6).

fields.name: mint
docs: The gated mint.

fields.name: wallet
docs: The affiliate's wallet (a seller).

fields.name: window_start
docs: When the current window opened (0 = no sale yet).

fields.name: window_qty
docs: Base units sold in the current window.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump.

types.name: AffiliateSet
docs: Emitted by `register_affiliate` / `deregister_affiliate` (CG-P7).

types.name: AttestationRef
docs: Which SAS attestation a decision rested on (#131): who signed it, under
which schema, and until when (`0` = SAS "never expires"). No PII: the
attestation's data stays behind `attestation_inputs_hash`.

fields.name: attestation
docs: The SAS attestation account.

fields.name: attester
docs: The attester that signed it (one of `MarketConfig::attesters`).

fields.name: schema
docs: Its SAS schema.

fields.name: expiry
docs: Its SAS expiry (unix seconds).

types.name: BlockEntry
docs: One blocked wallet. Existence is the block; closing it unblocks.

fields.name: mint
docs: The gated mint.

fields.name: wallet
docs: The blocked wallet.

fields.name: reason_hash
docs: Hash of the off-chain reason (sanctions list hit, court order, …).
Never the reason itself: no PII on-chain.

fields.name: blocked_at
docs: When it was blocked.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump.

types.name: BlockList
docs: Header of one market's block-list. `MarketConfig::blocklist` points here
once `initialize_blocklist` has run.

fields.name: mint
docs: The gated mint.

fields.name: entries
docs: Live entries (wallets currently blocked).

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump.

types.name: BlocklistUpdated
docs: Emitted by `block_wallet` / `unblock_wallet` (CG-P5, CG-P7).

fields.name: mint
docs: The gated mint.

fields.name: wallet
docs: The wallet added or removed.

fields.name: blocked
docs: `true` = blocked, `false` = unblocked.

fields.name: reason_hash
docs: Reason hash (the entry's, on unblock).

fields.name: entries
docs: Live entries after this instruction.

fields.name: authority
docs: The gate-config authority that signed.

types.name: ComplianceUpdate
docs: `update_compliance` arguments: one `Option` per layout-v2 field, `None`
= leave as is (like `update_config`).

types.name: ConfigUpdated
docs: CG-P7: every state change emits exactly one event from these families.

fields.name: mint
docs: The gated mint whose config this is (#96): the market key, so an
indexer can file the event per market without the config address.

fields.name: field_group
docs: Bitmask of the fields this instruction wrote ([`field_group`]).
`INIT` plus every field set on creation; on update, one bit per
supplied argument. `field_group` and `field_group_ext` are never
both 0: an update that writes nothing is rejected.

fields.name: new_config_hash
docs: SHA-256 of the post-update config (`MarketConfig::fingerprint`):
every governed field, domain-separated. No PII.

fields.name: authority
docs: Authority that performed the update (the payer on `migrate_config`,
which writes only defaults).

fields.name: field_group_ext
docs: Bitmask of the compliance-tail fields written ([`field_group_ext`], #202).
Appended: decoders of the v1 event read the prefix unchanged.

types.name: Custodian
docs: A wallet allowed to hold lots for others on one market (LF-P5).

types.name: CustodianSet
docs: Emitted by `register_custodian` / `deregister_custodian`.

types.name: ExemptionClass
docs: The market's exemption / jurisdiction class (CG-3, doc 07 L3, L14, L26,
L27). Wire-stable (borsh index); append only. It narrows what
[`MarketPolicy`] already allows; it never widens it.

types.name: GateAuthorityTransfer
docs: Emitted by the gate-authority hand-over instructions (#50). Exactly one
per instruction. `kind`: 0 = proposed, 1 = cancelled, 2 = accepted.
On `accepted` the config changed: `new_config_hash` is its fingerprint,
otherwise it is the unchanged config's fingerprint.

fields.name: kind
docs: 0 = proposed, 1 = cancelled, 2 = accepted.

fields.name: mint
docs: The gated mint.

fields.name: old_authority
docs: `gate_config_authority` before this instruction.

fields.name: new_authority
docs: The proposed (or, on accept, the now-current) authority.

fields.name: new_config_hash
docs: `MarketConfig::fingerprint()` after this instruction.

types.name: GateReject
docs: Typed rejection reasons (CG-P7). Wire-stable; human-readable mapping
lives off-chain (ME-5/UI).

types.name: GateRoot
docs: Who may create `MarketConfig`s (#93). One per program, seeded once by
the upgrade authority while the program is still upgradeable.
`initialize_config` authorizes against `authority` here, not against
`ProgramData`, so market onboarding (CG-P2 per mint, G14) survives
`solana program finalize`: doc 06 §11 U1 stages the program to immutable,
and an initializer pinned to the upgrade authority would die with it.
Seed this **before** finalizing — a finalized program with no root can
never onboard a market (fail-closed, nobody else can seed it).

fields.name: authority
docs: Signs `initialize_config`; pays its rent and becomes each new
config's first `gate_config_authority`.

fields.name: pending_authority
docs: Successor named by `propose_root_authority`; default = none pending.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump.

types.name: GateRootAuthority
docs: Emitted by the gate-root instructions (#93). Exactly one per
instruction. `kind`: 0 = seeded, 1 = proposed, 2 = cancelled,
3 = accepted.

fields.name: kind
docs: 0 = seeded, 1 = proposed, 2 = cancelled, 3 = accepted.

fields.name: old_authority
docs: `GateRoot.authority` before this instruction (default when seeded).

fields.name: new_authority
docs: The proposed key (proposed / cancelled) or the authority after this
instruction (seeded / accepted).

types.name: HolderLink
docs: One admitted wallet (CG-P4: wallet → investor_id). Field order is part
of the Token ACL interface: the extra-account metas read the two
attestation addresses at fixed offsets ([`HolderLink::IDENTITY_OFFSET`]).

fields.name: mint
docs: The gated mint.

fields.name: owner
docs: The holder wallet.

fields.name: identity_attestation
docs: SAS identity attestation the admission rests on.

fields.name: accreditation_attestation
docs: SAS accreditation attestation the admission rests on.

fields.name: investor_id
docs: From the identity attestation.

fields.name: validated_at
docs: Last successful `validate`.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump.

types.name: HolderLots
docs: The ledger for one `(mint, holder)`.

fields.name: mint
docs: The gated mint.

fields.name: holder
docs: The holder wallet.

fields.name: free_qty
docs: Seasoned quantity, no longer tracked per lot.

fields.name: next_lot_id
docs: Next `lot_id` to assign.

fields.name: lot_count
docs: Live entries in `lots`, packed at the front.

fields.name: lots
docs: Seasoning lots; `lots[lot_count..]` are zeroed.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump.

types.name: HolderReleased
docs: Emitted when a wallet is released (CG-P4 decrement).

fields.name: investor_exited
docs: The investor's last wallet went, so it left the count.

types.name: InvestorRecord
docs: One admitted investor and how many of its wallets are admitted.

types.name: Lot
docs: One seasoning lot. A split keeps every field but `lot_id` and `qty`.

fields.name: lot_id
docs: Ledger-local id, never reused.

fields.name: qty
docs: Base units.

fields.name: acquired_ts
docs: When the holder acquired it.

fields.name: restriction_expiry
docs: Sellable at or after this time: `acquired_ts + seasoning_seconds`.

fields.name: source
docs: Primary mint or auction.

fields.name: affiliate
docs: Acquired by an affiliate of the issuer (doc 07 L6: affiliate resale
rules differ). Enforced through the seller's [`crate::AffiliateRecord`]
(#202): while a market's affiliate limit is on, a seller holding a
lot flagged here cannot sell until it is registered, and a
registered affiliate's sales count against the window.

fields.name: exemption_path
docs: Exemption the acquisition relied on (code; mapping off-chain, like
`GateReject`).

types.name: LotDraw
docs: Quantity a sale took from one lot (or from FREE, [`FREE_LOT_ID`]).

types.name: LotEvent
docs: Emitted for every lot-ledger change (CG-P3, CG-P7). Same family as the
skeleton's `LotEvent`, extended with the lot id and holder FREE balance.

fields.name: kind
docs: 0 = append, 1 = split, 2 = merge-to-free. A sale's debit is evented
as [`crate::SettleChecked`], which lists every lot it drew from.

fields.name: mint
docs: Gated mint.

fields.name: owner
docs: Lot owner.

fields.name: lot_id
docs: Append: the new lot. Split: the new (split-off) lot. Merge: 0.

fields.name: qty
docs: Quantity affected (base units): appended, split off, or merged.

fields.name: restriction_expiry
docs: Append/split: the lot's seasoning expiry. Merge: the merge time.

fields.name: free_qty
docs: Holder's FREE bucket after this change.

types.name: LotSource
docs: Where a lot came from. Wire-stable; append only.

types.name: LotsMoved
docs: Emitted by every custody move (CG-P7).

fields.name: kind
docs: [`move_kind`].

fields.name: to_holder
docs: The receiving holder; the issuer's key on an issuer custody sale.

fields.name: free_qty
docs: Of `qty`, how much moved as FREE (already seasoned and merged).

fields.name: lots
docs: Lots moved with their own dates (0 on a sale).

types.name: MarketConfig
docs: One immutable-per-market policy configuration (CG-P2).
Seeded per-mint. Every consumer (auction-engine sessions, facility
underwriting) snapshots the fields it depends on — the gate never
mutates config mid-session (L5 snapshot discipline). Updates are
governed by `gate_config_authority` and always evented (CG-P7).

fields.name: mint
docs: The gated mint this config governs.

fields.name: gate_config_authority
docs: Sole authority for this PDA. Starts as the gate root authority that
initialized it (#93; a single bootstrap key on devnet today, see
DEPLOYMENTS.md). Moves to the Squads 2-of-2 vault (SRS 08 §8) only
through `propose_gate_authority` + `accept_gate_authority`.

fields.name: policy_class
docs: Policy class (pilot: `PILOT_506C_TEST`) — stable u32 for consumers.

fields.name: identity_schema
docs: Accepted SAS identity schema (`nundina.identity.v1`, CG-P4/P6).
`eligibility::evaluate` (called by `validate`, `settle_check` and
`settle_check_rofr`) accepts an identity attestation only if it is a
SAS-owned account at its canonical PDA `["attestation", credential,
schema, holder]`, under `MarketPolicy::credential`, with this schema.

fields.name: accreditation_schema
docs: Accepted SAS accreditation schema (`nundina.accreditation.v1`,
CG-P6). Checked the same way as `identity_schema`.

fields.name: attesters
docs: Attester authorities accepted for these schemas. An attestation whose
SAS `signer` is not in `attesters[..attester_count]` is rejected
(`AttestationInvalid`); one expiring before now +
`settlement_horizon_seconds` is rejected (`AttestationExpiry`, H4).

fields.name: attester_count
docs: Active count into `attesters`.

fields.name: holder_cap
docs: Distinct investor_id cap (pilot: 8, CG-P4).

fields.name: seasoning_seconds
docs: Seasoning seconds (pilot: 7 days — compressed Rule-144 analog, CG-1).

fields.name: settlement_horizon_seconds
docs: Attestation must remain valid at least this long after validation (H4).

fields.name: blocklist
docs: Block-list header (CG-P5, [`BlockList`]). `None` = no list
configured: the screen passes. Set by `initialize_blocklist`;
re-pointable but never clearable. Pointing it anywhere but this
program's header for the mint makes every screen fail closed.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump.

types.name: MarketPolicy
docs: Per-market eligibility policy and the holder governor's count.

fields.name: mint
docs: The gated mint.

fields.name: credential
docs: The SAS credential this market accepts attestations under.

fields.name: jurisdictions
docs: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes allowed to hold; `[..jurisdiction_count]`.

fields.name: jurisdiction_count
docs: Live entries in `jurisdictions`.

fields.name: min_kyc_level
docs: Minimum `kyc_level` in the identity attestation.

fields.name: require_accreditation
docs: `accredited == true` required (Rule 506(c) policy classes).

fields.name: distinct_investors
docs: Distinct `investor_id`s currently admitted (CG-P4).

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump.

types.name: PendingGateAuthority
docs: A pending hand-over of one market's `gate_config_authority` (#50).
Exists only between `propose_gate_authority` and accept/cancel.

fields.name: mint
docs: The gated mint whose config is being handed over.

fields.name: proposed_by
docs: The authority that proposed (and paid rent; refunded on close).

fields.name: new_authority
docs: The key that must sign `accept_gate_authority`.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump.

types.name: PolicyUpdated
docs: Emitted by `initialize_policy` / `update_policy`.

types.name: SeizureRecorded
docs: Emitted by `record_seizure` (D14, doc 09 Path 7): one per
permanent-delegate transfer, so delegate use is indexed.

fields.name: mint
docs: The gated mint whose permanent delegate moved the units.

fields.name: from
docs: The wallet the units were taken from.

fields.name: to
docs: The wallet (or account owner) they went to.

fields.name: amount
docs: Base units moved.

fields.name: reason_hash
docs: Hash of the off-chain basis (court order, sanctions action, …).
Never the reason itself: no PII on-chain.

fields.name: authority
docs: The gate-config authority that recorded it.

fields.name: recorded_at
docs: When it was recorded.

types.name: SettleChecked
docs: Emitted once per passed settle-time check (CG-P7).

fields.name: buyer
docs: The buyer, or the issuer on the ROFR path.

fields.name: seller_free_qty
docs: Seller's FREE bucket after the debit.

types.name: SettleOutcome
docs: What a passed check hands back to payment-rails (return data).

fields.name: draws
docs: The seller's lots the fill drew from, at most [`crate::MAX_DRAWS`].

fields.name: exemption_path
docs: [`exemption`] code the transfer relies on.

fields.name: buyer_lot_id
docs: The buyer's new lot; `None` on the ROFR path.

types.name: ValidateDecision
docs: Emitted on every `validate` decision (CG-P1, CG-P7).

fields.name: reject
docs: Rejection reason; `None` = approved.

fields.name: mint
docs: The gated mint.

fields.name: owner
docs: Owner whose eligibility was decided.

fields.name: attestation_inputs_hash
docs: SHA-256 over both attestation addresses and data (no PII on-chain).

fields.name: identity
docs: The identity attestation the approval rests on (#131). All zero on
a rejection: `reject` says why, and nothing was admitted.

fields.name: accreditation
docs: The accreditation attestation read; zero as for `identity`.

fields.name: distinct_investors
docs: Distinct investors admitted after this decision.
